identity.title: It's the New Year! Pocket Monsters Special!

leadText: (Japanese: お正月だよ！ポケットモンスタースペシャル！ It's the New Year! Special!) is a two-hour special, which included a special 90-minute clip show, that aired immediately after the original broadcast of the episode The Fourth Round Rumble.
plainText:
(Japanese: お正月だよ！ポケットモンスタースペシャル！ It's the New Year! Special!) is a two-hour special, which included a special 90-minute clip show, that aired immediately after the original broadcast of the episode The Fourth Round Rumble.

 

==Plot==
This clip shows summarized events up until The Fourth Round Rumble.

==Trivia==
The opening is suspected to have been mostly the same as It's New Year's Eve! Pocket Monsters Encore, because most of that portion's clips are from episodes 1-37, and very few come from episodes that aired in 1998.
